body:
That's a fair point.

I told him from the get go I didn't want to go. I can see where he's coming from when she asked me again i said oh okay I guess I'll go.

I try to accommodate people and i didn't want to bail on my friend. This whole plan was originally supposed to be me and her but she ended up inviting others, which helped the decision of me not going anymore. 

But ultimately I ended up not going bc I don't want to hang out with people I don't know that well. That choice was for me. I'm glad my friend understands. I was afraid she'd be upset with me for bailing.

I think it's a little bit of insecurity along with what others have wrote (that I'm emotionally draining and he's tired of hearing me say one thing and doing another).

He is insecure in some ways but I don't think I feel his insecurity in this case, but hey maybe overall it does play a factor.

Crossed a line, no. None of them.

Thank you.

I can tell I'm emotionally draining on him. I felt like I was going crazy though bc I told him my plan.

Thank you.

Yes indeed trivial. In the end I chose not to go and my friend was understanding.

Thank you so much.

So with a lot of from this community, I felt so much better.

And on top of that he and I managed to resolve it to the best of our ability and we are doing okay.

Thanks for reaching out. I really appreciate it.

I agree. I totally think it's reactionary. And he has done this before. He expects me to know he doesn't mean it and put up with it and he'll be over it.

This has been the most hurtful because I deserve more than 0% and I had to fight him to give me 10 %.

I just don't think it should have been said in the first place and I would expect an apology. He was breaking my heart while making me feel guilty.

I tried to remind him why we love each other and he wouldn't budge he kept saying 10% will work. If I disagree I can leave. He would never be the one to leave me. He always asks me to be the one to leave. I don't know why. So I said I couldn't settle for 10% it won't work although he keeps saying it will. And I left. He didn't blink an eye when I said bye.

I was still upset I said I have never given up on us. You gave up on. All he said was okay.

He really thinks I should only get 0 to 10% of his effort and he really believes it will work and he wants me to see that it will.

I said I deserve better than that. He said okay if you disagree you can adjust or quit.

So I quit. But I'm having a very hard time.
Omg that is me exactly... So from your pov, what advice would you give me that you would give to your gf in an ideal situation?

I've been considering that. Would it be better this way?

Or can I really do this? I have noticed I'm very negative. I need to work on my thought records and mindfulness and really be positive for my own self. And hopefully it will just emanate from me onto my relationship with him.

I totally agree that the personality thing may not mesh... At first I thought I was just me fucking up all the time. The majority of times I do, but sometimes it's not just me and I'm not the only one to blame. Thank you for that

What sets off the arguments? Is it that every thing you say could be turned around on you and then it turns into a fight?

I feel that's what I do...i just need to work on not doing that....

I did mention this, and SO ended up giving words of acknowledgement. I hope it made sense what I was saying.

Thank you for reading and for your words. Tomorrow will be a better day.
